## Summary by CodeRabbit

- New Features
  - Exposed safeAllocUint8Array and MAX_LENGTH in utils for safer buffer allocation.
- Refactor
  - Replaced direct Uint8Array allocations across core modules with safeAllocUint8Array for improved robustness; no API changes.
- Bug Fixes
  - Prevents oversized buffer allocations from causing instability by clamping to a safe maximum and logging warnings.
- Tests
  - Added unit tests validating allocator length and clamping behavior.
- Chores
  - Added @typeberry/logger dependency to support allocation warnings.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Adds a new safe Uint8Array allocator utility and applies it across many modules by replacing direct Uint8Array allocations. Updates imports accordingly, introduces tests, re-exports the new utility, and adds a logger dependency for warnings. No control-flow or public API changes beyond default parameter initialization in TrieNode.
